scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.mkdirSync('dist/web', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('src/web/style.css', 'dist/web/style.css');"
